title: Cryo-electron tomographic investigation of native hippocampal glutamatergic synapses - Tomogram 3
citation: Matsui A., Spangler C., Elferich J., Shiozaki M., Jean N., Zhao X., Qin M., Zhong H., Yu Z., Gouaux E. eLife 13:RP98458 (2024). doi 10.7554/eLife.98458
sample: Mouse (C57BL/6, vGlut1-mScarlet / PSD95-EGFP) hippocampus CA1 stratum radiatum, unfixed tissue slice, high pressure frozen, cryo-FIB lamella about 200 nm; anti-GluA2 Fab gold labels the AMPA receptors
imaging: Titan Krios 300 kV, K3, dose symmetric tilt series -68 to 28 degrees in 3 degree steps, RELION 4.0.1 back projection
processing: raw map values, 3 voxel mean through z, one contrast stretch (0.5 to 99.5 percentile) for the whole stack, 8 bit JPEG; no denoising, no segmentation
licence: EMDB entries are distributed without restriction (wwPDB CC0 1.0); EMPIAR-11984 holds the raw tilt series
